architecture.name: Causal Mass-Conserving Aggregate-conditioned Service-Set Temporal Point Process

modules.A_encoder: causal diagonal exponential-decay jump state-space over every irregular event plus 28-day macro MLP
modules.B_mass_head: nonnegative conditional mean and structurally monotone Q50/Q90
modules.D_service_set_decoder: 10,012 anonymous all-at-once queries evaluated in chunks of 512
modules.E_hard_reconciliation: float64 alpha-normalized allocation with final round-off residual correction

architecture.encoder_note: The user-provided GRUCell recurrence was a recommended reference. The implemented vectorized diagonal decay/jump SSM preserves all events and is CPU-feasible; encoder novelty is not claimed.

set_matching.large_sets: memory-bounded monotone 1-D OT with mark/mass costs

executed.B1: D-7 requested-service proxy with training-only scale

executed.B4: lightweight faithful patch-token Transformer over 28-day request proxy
executed.B5: RMTPP-style continuous-time recurrent/decay event adaptation with daily horizon head; not canonical next-event likelihood reproduction
